title: Bilingual ANVISA Regulatory RAG Prototype
description: Organization-only patch to the finalized v0.3.0 ANVISA RAG reviewer revision. Reorganizes Supplementary Data S16 into protocol, inputs, results, source audit, provenance, reproduction code and explicitly historical validation. Adds read-first guides, a manuscript-to-data map, file index and original-path/hash map. A portable recalculation reproduces the unchanged counts and intervals. All scientific documents, figures, assessments and results remain unchanged from v0.3.0. No new model calls. Current-law accuracy, independent external validation and workflow benefit remain unestablished. See the package guide and original v0.3.0 scientific snapshot.
